description: Audit a domain's email authentication DNS: SPF (record count, all qualifier, includes, ~DNS lookups vs 10 limit), DMARC (p, sp, pct, rua/ruf, adkim/aspf), DKIM (common or given selectors, key type and length), MX, plus BIMI / MTA-STS / TLS-RPT presence. Returns per-check status, issues, recommendations, score 0-100 and grade A-F. Costs $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

selectors.description: DKIM selectors to try. Default: google, selector1, selector2, default, k1, s1, s2, mail, dkim

name: domain_auth_check
